newsitem.title: EGYPT: Submarine to join U.S. forces in Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Submarine to join U.S. forces in Gulf.

text.p: The U.S. submarine Pittsburgh is waiting outside the Suez Canal en route to joining American forces in the Gulf, port officials said on Monday.
They said the nuclear-powered submarine, on its way to the Gulf from the Adriatic, will pass through the canal on Tuesday evening.
It will join the U.S. carrier Enterprise, which crossed the canal on Sunday, and the Carl Vinson carrier, both of which are assembled in the Gulf for possible military action against Iraq.
Among its arsenal, the Pittsburgh carries Tomahawk cruise missiles similar to those used in an attack against southern Iraq earlier this month.
